explanation: Zelinsky (JIS 5 (2002), 'Tau numbers: a partial proof of a conjecture'): Colton 'conjectured that the number of tau numbers <= n is at least 1/2 pi(n)', and Zelinsky shows it 'for all sufficiently large n'. The formal statement π(n) ≤ 2 · #{1 ≤ k ≤ n : τ(k) | k} for all n is exactly this pointwise conjecture. Faithful.
